issue_summary: Linux password rotation failed shortly after onboarding
investigation_findings: Historical snapshot: selected account configuration differed from approved local-account record.
documented_outcome: Owner corrected configuration in a separate approved change; subsequent historical validation passed. Current failure has no collected error and is not diagnosed.

investigation_findings: Sanitized historical logs showed an account restriction at the failure timestamp.
documented_outcome: Owner reviewed the restriction through the approved process; historical follow-up succeeded.

investigation_findings: Historical monitoring showed target unavailable during rotation.
documented_outcome: Target owner restored availability through an approved change; later rotation succeeded.

investigation_findings: Account ownership approval was missing from the onboarding record.
documented_outcome: Owner supplied approval; onboarding review resumed.

investigation_findings: Two inventory entries referred to the same synthetic account.
documented_outcome: Owner identified intended record through approved inventory review.

issue_summary: Custom web connector login element missing
investigation_findings: Sanitized test screenshots showed a changed application element label.
documented_outcome: Connector owner updated the test configuration through an approved change and validated it.

investigation_findings: Historical execution reached an expired-session page.
documented_outcome: Application owner documented expected session flow; approved test validation completed.

investigation_findings: Historical test encountered an interactive challenge unsupported by the documented integration.
documented_outcome: Escalated to application and security owners; no bypass attempted.

documented_outcome: Owner aligned the approved schedule after policy review; historical validation passed.
